achievements.trial_walker.text.text: Vuka madaraja {n} ya Majaribio ya Kivuli

battle.abilities.smoke_bomb.description.en: Throw it over your warriors as they walk into a defense's range. For 8 seconds, warriors inside the cloud can only be shot from close up (Night Blades also hit buildings inside it twice as hard).
battle.abilities.smoke_bomb.description.text: Lirushe juu ya wapiganaji wako wanapoingia kwenye masafa ya ulinzi. Kwa sekunde 8, wapiganaji walio ndani ya wingu wanaweza kupigwa tu kutoka karibu (Panga za Usiku pia hupiga majengo yaliyo ndani yake mara mbili zaidi).

battle.heroes.shadow_captain.description.en: Clan hero. On his first strike he rallies nearby warriors: 30% more damage for 8 seconds, once per battle.
battle.heroes.shadow_captain.description.text: Shujaa wa ukoo. Katika pigo lake la kwanza huwahamasisha wapiganaji walio karibu: madhara zaidi kwa 30% kwa sekunde 8, mara moja kwa kila vita.

buildings.elder_toadstool.description.en: The hidden heart of your clan. Upgrade it to unlock new buildings, warriors and higher levels.
buildings.elder_toadstool.description.text: Moyo uliofichwa wa ukoo wako. Iboreshe ili kufungua majengo mapya, wapiganaji na ngazi za juu zaidi.

buildings.acorn_orchard.description.en: Artisans stamp fresh Coins every hour. Holds 8 hours of output, so collect often.
buildings.acorn_orchard.description.text: Mafundi hupiga chapa Sarafu mpya kila saa. Huhifadhi mazao ya saa 8, kwa hiyo kusanya mara kwa mara.

buildings.dewdrop_well.description.en: Terraced fields that grow Provisions for your warriors. Holds 8 hours of output.
buildings.dewdrop_well.description.text: Mashamba ya matuta yanayozalisha Chakula kwa wapiganaji wako. Huhifadhi mazao ya saa 8.

buildings.acorn_silo.description.en: A locked vault for your Coins. Bigger treasuries let you save for bigger upgrades.
buildings.acorn_silo.description.text: Chumba kilichofungwa cha Sarafu zako. Hazina kubwa zaidi hukuwezesha kuweka akiba kwa maboresho makubwa zaidi.

buildings.dew_cistern.description.en: Stores Provisions for your warriors. Raiders can only carry off part of what is inside.
buildings.dew_cistern.description.text: Huhifadhi Chakula kwa wapiganaji wako. Wavamizi wanaweza kubeba sehemu tu ya kilichomo ndani.

buildings.beaver_lodge.description.en: Home of a Village Artisan. Each hut lets you build or upgrade one thing at a time.
buildings.beaver_lodge.description.text: Makazi ya Fundi wa Kijiji. Kila kibanda hukuwezesha kujenga au kuboresha kitu kimoja kwa wakati.

buildings.burrow_barracks.description.en: Trains warriors and studies battle scrolls to make them stronger. Higher levels unlock new warriors.
buildings.burrow_barracks.description.text: Hufunza wapiganaji na kusoma magombo ya vita ili kuwaimarisha. Ngazi za juu hufungua wapiganaji wapya.

buildings.army_camp.description.en: Where trained warriors wait for the next raid. Each level houses more.
buildings.army_camp.description.text: Mahali wapiganaji waliofunzwa husubiri uvamizi unaofuata. Kila ngazi huchukua wengi zaidi.

buildings.acorn_cannon.description.en: A lookout that throws volleys of kunai at warriors on the ground. Cannot hit flyers.
buildings.acorn_cannon.description.text: Mnara wa ulinzi unaorusha mfululizo wa kunai kwa wapiganaji walio ardhini. Hauwezi kupiga wanaoruka.

buildings.pinecone_catapult.description.en: Launches bursting fireworks that splash groups of warriors on the ground. Slow, and blind to warriors right beside it.
buildings.pinecone_catapult.description.text: Hurusha fataki zinazolipuka na kupiga makundi ya wapiganaji walio ardhini. Ni wa polepole, na hauwaoni wapiganaji walio kando yake kabisa.

buildings.wasp_nest.description.en: Spinning shuriken strike warriors on the ground and in the air.
buildings.wasp_nest.description.text: Shuriken zinazozunguka hupiga wapiganaji walio ardhini na angani.

buildings.firefly_tower.description.en: Archers with great bows that hit flying warriors hard. Ignores warriors on the ground.
buildings.firefly_tower.description.text: Wapiga mishale wenye pinde kubwa wanaopiga kwa nguvu wapiganaji wanaoruka. Hawajali wapiganaji walio ardhini.

buildings.bramble_hedge.description.en: Fitted mountain stone. Warriors walk around it or break through it. Higher levels add iron-banded gates. Builds instantly.
buildings.bramble_hedge.description.text: Mawe ya mlimani yaliyopangwa vizuri. Wapiganaji huzunguka au huvunja ukuta. Ngazi za juu huongeza malango yenye kingo za chuma. Hujengwa papo hapo.

buildings.thorn_snare.description.en: A hidden pit of bamboo spikes that springs when warriors on the ground step close. Unseen until it goes off.
buildings.thorn_snare.description.text: Shimo lililofichwa lenye miiba ya mianzi linalofyatuka wapiganaji wa ardhini wanapokaribia. Halionekani hadi lifyatuke.

buildings.sap_puddle.description.en: Hidden iron caltrops that slow warriors on the ground to half speed for a few seconds.
buildings.sap_puddle.description.text: Misumari ya chuma iliyofichwa inayopunguza kasi ya wapiganaji wa ardhini hadi nusu kwa sekunde chache.

buildings.flower_bed.description.en: A carefully shaped little pine. Purely decorative.
buildings.flower_bed.description.text: Msonobari mdogo uliotengenezwa kwa uangalifu. Ni pambo tu.

buildings.lantern_post.description.en: A carved stone lantern that glows through the night. Purely decorative.
buildings.lantern_post.description.text: Taa ya jiwe iliyochongwa inayong'aa usiku kucha. Ni pambo tu.

buildings.mushroom_ring.description.en: Raked gravel and three quiet stones. Purely decorative.
buildings.mushroom_ring.description.text: Changarawe iliyochorwa na mawe matatu tulivu. Ni pambo tu.

buildings.mossy_statue.description.en: A weathered stone sentinel that watches the gate. Purely decorative.
buildings.mossy_statue.description.text: Mlinzi wa jiwe aliyechakaa anayelinda lango. Ni pambo tu.

buildings.obstacle_bush.description.en: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_bush.description.text: Kiondoe ili kupata nafasi. Huenda ukapata Jade!

buildings.obstacle_stump.description.en: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_stump.description.text: Uondoe ili kupata nafasi. Huenda ukapata Jade!

buildings.obstacle_rock.description.en: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_rock.description.text: Liondoe ili kupata nafasi. Huenda ukapata Jade!

buildings.grove_lodge.description.en: Your link to your Alliance. Holds the warriors your allies send you, ready for your next raid.
buildings.grove_lodge.description.text: Kiungo chako na Muungano wako. Huhifadhi wapiganaji ambao washirika wako wanakutumia, tayari kwa uvamizi wako unaofuata.

buildings.paper_lantern_line.description.en: Lanterns strung low between posts. Hidden or mist-veiled ground warriors within 2 tiles are lit up for a few seconds: defenses can see them, and lit warriors take extra damage. Once it has lit someone, the line itself is no longer hidden.
buildings.paper_lantern_line.description.text: Taa zilizoning'inizwa chini kati ya nguzo. Wapiganaji wa ardhini waliofichwa au waliofunikwa na ukungu ndani ya vigae 2 huangaziwa kwa sekunde chache: ulinzi unaweza kuwaona, na wapiganaji walioangaziwa hupata madhara zaidi. Ukishamwangazia mtu, mstari wenyewe haufichiki tena.

buildings.clockwork_repairer.description.en: A mechanic's crane that reaches over nearby defenses: jams, stuns and a Hawk Tamer's slowing on defenses within 3 tiles are cut short. A few repairs per battle.
buildings.clockwork_repairer.description.text: Kreni ya fundi mitambo inayofika juu ya ulinzi ulio karibu: ukwamishaji, kupigwa butwaa na upunguzaji wa kasi wa Mfugaji Mwewe kwenye ulinzi ndani ya vigae 3 hukatizwa mapema. Matengenezo machache kwa kila vita.

buildings.bitter_incense_burner.descript.en: Burns bitter herbs: warriors within 3 tiles receive less healing, and healing, haste and toughness auras and shelter shields work at reduced strength on them.
buildings.bitter_incense_burner.descript.text: Huchoma mitishamba michungu: wapiganaji ndani ya vigae 3 hupokea uponyaji mdogo, na nguvu za uponyaji, kasi, ustahimilivu na ngao za hifadhi hufanya kazi kwa nguvu iliyopunguzwa juu yao.

buildings.kite_cutter_ballista.descripti.en: Air only. Fires a spinning bolas that tangles anything with wings or strings: a flyer it hits is grounded for 3 seconds, where ground defenses can reach it. A flyer that breaks free can't be tangled again for 3 seconds.
buildings.kite_cutter_ballista.descripti.text: Kwa angani tu. Hufyatua kamba yenye mawe inayozunguka na kunasa chochote chenye mabawa au nyuzi: anayeruka akipigwa huangushwa chini kwa sekunde 3, ambapo ulinzi wa ardhini unaweza kumfikia. Anayeruka akijinasua hawezi kunaswa tena kwa sekunde 3.

buildings.longbow_yagura.description.en: A tall archery tower with range 13 that outranges every siege warrior. It prefers warriors attacking from 3.5 tiles or more (throwers and artillery), but cannot hit anything closer than 2 tiles.
buildings.longbow_yagura.description.text: Mnara mrefu wa mishale wenye masafa 13 unaozidi masafa ya kila mpiganaji wa kuzingira. Hupendelea wapiganaji wanaoshambulia kutoka vigae 3.5 au zaidi (warushaji na mizinga), lakini hauwezi kupiga chochote kilicho karibu zaidi ya vigae 2.

events.schedule.harvest_moon.description.en: Collecting from Coin Mints and Terraced Farms gives 30% extra.
events.schedule.harvest_moon.description.text: Kukusanya kutoka Viwanda vya Sarafu na Mashamba ya Matuta kunatoa 30% zaidi.

events.schedule.raiders_moon.description.text: Mashambulio ya ushindi huleta nyara zaidi kwa 20%.

events.schedule.swift_paws.description.text: Kufunza wapiganaji kunagharimu Chakula pungufu kwa 25%.

events.schedule.bounty_hunt.description.en: A rival warlord's fortress has a bounty on it. Attack it as often as you like while the hunt lasts: each mark on the reward ladder pays once.
events.schedule.bounty_hunt.description.text: Ngome ya mbabe wa vita mpinzani ina zawadi juu yake. Ishambulie mara nyingi upendavyo wakati uwindaji unaendelea: kila alama kwenye ngazi ya zawadi hulipa mara moja.

events.schedule.raiders_moon_2.descripti.text: Mashambulio ya ushindi huleta nyara zaidi kwa 20%.

names.rivalClans.crimson_lotus.bio.en: A river clan that trades in secrets. Akane never fights where she can be seen; her outposts lean on traps and mortars.
names.rivalClans.crimson_lotus.bio.text: Ukoo wa mtoni unaofanya biashara ya siri. Akane hapigani kamwe mahali anapoweza kuonekana; vituo vyake vya nje hutegemea mitego na mizinga.

names.rivalClans.iron_tide.bio.en: Salt-hardened raiders from the coast. Gorō builds thick walls and dares you to break them.
names.rivalClans.iron_tide.bio.text: Wavamizi wa pwani waliokomazwa na chumvi. Gorō hujenga kuta nene na kukuthubutu uzivunje.

names.rivalClans.moon_veil.bio.en: Mountain hermits who see in the dark. Yoru spreads her towers wide so no path is safe.
names.rivalClans.moon_veil.bio.text: Wakaa-pweke wa milimani wanaoona gizani. Yoru hutawanya minara yake mbali mbali ili hakuna njia iliyo salama.

notifications.types.dailyChest.label.text: Kasha la kila siku liko tayari

notifications.types.gangWar.label.en: Gang War found, battle day, 2 hours left, relay turn, under attack (online)
notifications.types.gangWar.label.text: Vita vya Genge vimepatikana, siku ya vita, saa 2 zimebaki, zamu ya kupokezana, unashambuliwa (mtandaoni)

notifications.types.friends.label.en: Friend requests, duels and duel challenges (online)
notifications.types.friends.label.text: Maombi ya urafiki, mapambano na changamoto za mapambano (mtandaoni)

offers.rules.starter_pack.description.en: A one-time boost for new clan leaders: Jade and resources to speed things up.
offers.rules.starter_pack.description.text: Msukumo wa mara moja kwa viongozi wapya wa ukoo: Jade na rasilimali za kuharakisha mambo.

offers.rules.builder_pack.description.en: Jade to hire another Village Artisan, plus a little extra.
offers.rules.builder_pack.description.text: Jade ya kuajiri Fundi mwingine wa Kijiji, pamoja na nyongeza kidogo.

offers.rules.war_prep_pack.description.en: Get ready for the Alliance War: Provisions for your warriors, and Jade.
offers.rules.war_prep_pack.description.text: Jiandae kwa Vita vya Muungano: Chakula kwa wapiganaji wako, na Jade.

offers.rules.keep_pack.description.en: Your Keep grew. Supplies sized for your new Keep level, and Jade.
offers.rules.keep_pack.description.text: Ngome yako imekua. Mahitaji yaliyopimwa kwa ngazi mpya ya Ngome yako, na Jade.

offers.rules.rebuild_pack.description.en: Raiders hit hard. Restock your storage.
offers.rules.rebuild_pack.description.text: Wavamizi walipiga kwa nguvu. Jaza tena maghala yako.

pass.weeklyChallenges.w_destruction.text.en: Destroy {n}% in raids this week (added up)
pass.weeklyChallenges.w_destruction.text.text: Haribu {n}% katika mavamizi wiki hii (kwa jumla)

pass.weeklyChallenges.w_trials.text.en: Clear {n} new Shadow Trial tiers this week
pass.weeklyChallenges.w_trials.text.text: Vuka madaraja mapya {n} ya Majaribio ya Kivuli wiki hii

progression.roles.blade.summary.en: Fast melee that strikes the nearest building.
progression.roles.blade.summary.text: Mpiganaji wa karibu mwepesi anayeshambulia jengo lililo karibu zaidi.

progression.roles.thrower.summary.en: Fragile ranged damage from behind the front line.
progression.roles.thrower.summary.text: Madhara ya mbali, dhaifu, kutoka nyuma ya mstari wa mbele.

progression.roles.guardian.summary.en: Armored frontliner that walks into defenses and soaks fire.
progression.roles.guardian.summary.text: Mpiganaji wa mbele mwenye silaha nzito anayeingia kwenye ulinzi na kuhimili moto.

progression.roles.saboteur.summary.en: Specialist that disables defenses for a short time.
progression.roles.saboteur.summary.text: Mtaalamu anayezima ulinzi kwa muda mfupi.

progression.roles.infiltrator.summary.en: Gets past walls by tunnel, rope or rooftop.
progression.roles.infiltrator.summary.text: Hupita kuta kwa handaki, kamba au juu ya paa.

progression.roles.sky.summary.en: Flies over everything; only anti-air can touch it, so it is fragile and hits lighter.
progression.roles.sky.summary.text: Huruka juu ya kila kitu; ni kinga ya angani tu inayoweza kumgusa, kwa hiyo ni dhaifu na hupiga kwa wepesi.

progression.roles.mystic.summary.en: Supports nearby warriors: heals, haste, shields.
progression.roles.mystic.summary.text: Husaidia wapiganaji walio karibu: uponyaji, kasi, ngao.

progression.roles.siege.summary.en: Breaks walls and buildings fast; weak against defenses.
progression.roles.siege.summary.text: Huvunja kuta na majengo haraka; dhaifu dhidi ya ulinzi.

progression.roles.beast.summary.en: Handlers and their animals: numbers and charges.
progression.roles.beast.summary.text: Wafugaji na wanyama wao: wingi na mashambulio ya kasi.

progression.buildingCatalog.scroll_libra.en: Moves warrior research out of the Training Dojo and studies mastery scrolls.
progression.buildingCatalog.scroll_libra.text: Huhamisha utafiti wa wapiganaji kutoka Dojo ya Mafunzo na kusoma magombo ya ustadi.

progression.buildingCatalog.shadow_ink_w.en: Distils Shadow Ink, the third currency, used for Veteran-tier warriors and heroes.
progression.buildingCatalog.shadow_ink_w.text: Hutoneza Wino wa Kivuli, sarafu ya tatu, inayotumika kwa wapiganaji wa daraja la Mkongwe na mashujaa.

progression.buildingCatalog.reinforced_g.en: A wall segment with an iron-banded gate; tougher than stone and opens only for defenders.
progression.buildingCatalog.reinforced_g.text: Sehemu ya ukuta yenye lango lililofungwa kwa chuma; ngumu kuliko jiwe na hufunguka kwa walinzi tu.

progression.buildingCatalog.sky_net.desc.en: Hidden net that snares flyers for a few seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.sky_net.desc.text: Wavu uliofichwa unaonasa wanaoruka kwa sekunde chache.

progression.buildingCatalog.hero_shrine..en: Home of a clan hero; one hall per hero.
progression.buildingCatalog.hero_shrine..text: Makazi ya shujaa wa ukoo; ukumbi mmoja kwa kila shujaa.

progression.buildingCatalog.temple_bell_.en: Rings when warriors approach: reveals Shadow warriors and halves smoke duration nearby.
progression.buildingCatalog.temple_bell_.text: Hulia wapiganaji wanapokaribia: hufichua wapiganaji wa Kivuli na hupunguza nusu muda wa moshi karibu nao.

progression.buildingCatalog.clan_forge.d.en: Forges equipment that adds small bonuses to one role at a time.
progression.buildingCatalog.clan_forge.d.text: Hufua vifaa vinavyoongeza bonasi ndogo kwa kazi moja kwa wakati.

progression.buildingCatalog.wind_chime_w.en: Tripwire that slows and reveals everything that crosses it.
progression.buildingCatalog.wind_chime_w.text: Waya wa mtego unaopunguza kasi na kufichua kila kinachouvuka.

progression.buildingCatalog.crossbow_bas.en: Fires at three targets at once.
progression.buildingCatalog.crossbow_bas.text: Hufyatua kwa malengo matatu kwa wakati mmoja.

progression.buildingCatalog.flame_trench.en: A trench that bursts into flame under warriors on the ground.
progression.buildingCatalog.flame_trench.text: Mtaro unaolipuka kwa moto chini ya wapiganaji walio ardhini.

progression.buildingCatalog.thunder_shri.en: Chain lightning that jumps between flyers.
progression.buildingCatalog.thunder_shri.text: Radi ya mnyororo inayoruka kati ya wanaoruka angani.

progression.buildingCatalog.ninja_watch_.en: Sends out defending ninja who chase attackers.

progression.buildingCatalog.great_dragon.en: The keep's last word: enormous damage, very slow.
progression.buildingCatalog.great_dragon.text: Neno la mwisho la ngome: madhara makubwa mno, polepole sana.

progression.buildingCatalog.whirling_bla.en: Short-range spinning blades hit every ground warrior within 1.2 tiles. Punishes cheap melee swarms; useless against anything that stands back.
progression.buildingCatalog.whirling_bla.text: Visu vinavyozunguka vya masafa mafupi hupiga kila mpiganaji wa ardhini ndani ya vigae 1.2. Huadhibu makundi ya wapiganaji wa karibu wa bei nafuu; haufai kitu dhidi ya chochote kinachosimama mbali.

progression.buildingCatalog.paper_lanter.en: Lanterns strung low between posts. Hidden or mist-veiled ground warriors within 2 tiles are lit up for a few seconds: defenses can see them, and lit warriors take extra damage. Once it has lit someone, the line itself is no longer hidden.
progression.buildingCatalog.paper_lanter.text: Taa zilizoning'inizwa chini kati ya nguzo. Wapiganaji wa ardhini waliofichwa au waliofunikwa na ukungu ndani ya vigae 2 huangaziwa kwa sekunde chache: ulinzi unaweza kuwaona, na wapiganaji walioangaziwa hupata madhara zaidi. Ukishamwangazia mtu, mstari wenyewe haufichiki tena.

progression.buildingCatalog.rain_barrel_.en: Douses fire and rinses venom: burning and poison on buildings within 2.5 tiles end after 1 second, and firebomb splash there is 25% smaller. Wet ground conducts lightning, though.
progression.buildingCatalog.rain_barrel_.text: Huzima moto na kuosha sumu: kuungua na sumu kwenye majengo ndani ya vigae 2.5 huisha baada ya sekunde 1, na mlipuko wa mabomu ya moto pale ni mdogo kwa 25%. Lakini ardhi yenye maji hupitisha radi.

progression.buildingCatalog.listening_ja.en: Buried clay jars that amplify every sound underfoot. Diggers within 3 tiles are forced to the surface and stunned for 1 second; unseen walkers within 2 tiles are revealed.
progression.buildingCatalog.listening_ja.text: Mitungi ya udongo iliyozikwa inayokuza kila sauti ya chini ya ardhi. Wachimbaji ndani ya vigae 3 hulazimishwa kutoka juu na kupigwa butwaa kwa sekunde 1; wanaotembea bila kuonekana ndani ya vigae 2 hufichuliwa.

progression.buildingCatalog.living_bambo.en: A wall that grows back 3% of its health every second and is too springy to climb. Wall-breaking multipliers count half (a 4x ram hits for 2.5x).
progression.buildingCatalog.living_bambo.text: Ukuta unaorudisha 3% ya afya yake kila sekunde na unaonyumbulika mno kupandwa. Vizidisho vya kuvunja kuta vinahesabiwa nusu (gogo la kugonga la 4x hupiga 2.5x).

progression.buildingCatalog.clockwork_re.en: A mechanic's crane that reaches over nearby defenses: jams, stuns and a Hawk Tamer's slowing on defenses within 3 tiles are cut short. A few repairs per battle.
progression.buildingCatalog.clockwork_re.text: Kreni ya fundi mitambo inayofika juu ya ulinzi ulio karibu: ukwamishaji, kupigwa butwaa na upunguzaji wa kasi wa Mfugaji Mwewe kwenye ulinzi ndani ya vigae 3 hukatizwa mapema. Matengenezo machache kwa kila vita.

progression.buildingCatalog.bitter_incen.en: Burns bitter herbs: warriors within 3 tiles receive less healing, and healing, haste and toughness auras and shelter shields work at reduced strength on them.
progression.buildingCatalog.bitter_incen.text: Huchoma mitishamba michungu: wapiganaji ndani ya vigae 3 hupokea uponyaji mdogo, na nguvu za uponyaji, kasi, ustahimilivu na ngao za hifadhi hufanya kazi kwa nguvu iliyopunguzwa juu yao.

progression.buildingCatalog.straw_scarec.text: Sanamu ya Majani ya Kutisha Ndege

progression.buildingCatalog.straw_scarec.en: Animals cannot resist it, and birds are terrified of it. Beasts, their companions and charging mounts within 3 tiles must attack it first, and crane gliders swerve away from it. Lots of health, no damage, very flammable.
progression.buildingCatalog.straw_scarec.text: Wanyama hawawezi kuivumilia, na ndege huiogopa sana. Wanyama, wenzao na wanyama wa kupanda wanaoshambulia ndani ya vigae 3 lazima waishambulie kwanza, na wapaa-korongo huikwepa. Afya nyingi, haina madhara, huungua kwa urahisi sana.

progression.buildingCatalog.mirror_scree.en: Polished bronze panels: every third projectile that hits the screen flies back at whoever threw it. Melee warriors just walk up and smash it.
progression.buildingCatalog.mirror_scree.text: Paneli za shaba zilizong'arishwa: kila kombora la tatu linalogonga kioo hurudi kwa aliyelirusha. Wapiganaji wa karibu hutembea tu hadi kwake na kukivunja.

progression.buildingCatalog.sand_bucket_.en: A bucket crew that smothers explosions and embers: splash damage within 3 tiles is 30% smaller, and they defuse up to two planted charges per battle.
progression.buildingCatalog.sand_bucket_.text: Kikundi cha ndoo kinachozima milipuko na makaa: madhara ya mlipuko wa eneo ndani ya vigae 3 ni madogo kwa 30%, na hutegua hadi vilipuzi viwili vilivyotegwa kwa kila vita.

progression.buildingCatalog.kite_cutter_.en: Air only. Fires a spinning bolas that tangles anything with wings or strings: a flyer it hits is grounded for 3 seconds, where ground defenses can reach it. A flyer that breaks free can't be tangled again for 3 seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.kite_cutter_.text: Kwa angani tu. Hufyatua kamba yenye mawe inayozunguka na kunasa chochote chenye mabawa au nyuzi: anayeruka akipigwa huangushwa chini kwa sekunde 3, ambapo ulinzi wa ardhini unaweza kumfikia. Anayeruka akijinasua hawezi kunaswa tena kwa sekunde 3.

progression.buildingCatalog.discipline_b.en: A clan banner that keeps nearby defenders focused: defenses within 3 tiles ignore taunting bells and decoys.
progression.buildingCatalog.discipline_b.text: Bendera ya ukoo inayowafanya walinzi walio karibu wawe makini: ulinzi ndani ya vigae 3 hupuuza kengele za kuchokoza na vitu vya kudanganya.

progression.buildingCatalog.spotter_perc.en: A lookout who calls targets: defenses within 3 tiles retarget instantly onto warriors that dash, swing or shadow-step into range.
progression.buildingCatalog.spotter_perc.text: Mlinzi anayetaja malengo: ulinzi ndani ya vigae 3 hubadilisha lengo papo hapo kwa wapiganaji wanaoruka, kubembea au kuhama kwa kivuli hadi kwenye masafa.

progression.buildingCatalog.steam_vent.d.en: Blasts scalding steam in a 2-tile circle. It needs no target, so it hurts hidden warriors, blows smoke away from its tiles, and cannot be dodged.
progression.buildingCatalog.steam_vent.d.text: Hutoa mvuke wa moto mkali katika duara la vigae 2. Halihitaji lengo, kwa hiyo huwaumiza wapiganaji waliofichwa, hupeperusha moshi mbali na vigae vyake, na haliwezi kukwepwa.

progression.buildingCatalog.sleep_dart_t.en: Darts that barely scratch but put a warrior to sleep for 2 seconds. The same warrior can only be put to sleep once. Best against a few big fighters.
progression.buildingCatalog.sleep_dart_t.text: Mishale midogo inayokwaruza tu lakini humlaza mpiganaji kwa sekunde 2. Mpiganaji yule yule anaweza kulazwa mara moja tu. Bora dhidi ya wapiganaji wachache wakubwa.

progression.buildingCatalog.rolling_log_.en: Releases a log down a 1-tile lane: heavy damage to every ground warrior in the line. It is not splash, so tower shields do not stop it. Punishes clumped buff squads.
progression.buildingCatalog.rolling_log_.text: Huachia gogo kwenye mstari wa kigae 1: madhara makubwa kwa kila mpiganaji wa ardhini aliye kwenye mstari. Si mlipuko wa eneo, kwa hiyo ngao za mnara haziuzuii. Huadhibu vikosi vilivyobanana vya kuongeza nguvu.

progression.buildingCatalog.moonlit_grav.en: Raked gravel that crunches: anything that teleports, lands or rushes onto it is stunned for 1.5 seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.moonlit_grav.text: Changarawe inayolia ikikanyagwa: chochote kinachohamia kwa uchawi, kutua au kukimbilia juu yake hupigwa butwaa kwa sekunde 1.5.

progression.buildingCatalog.ink_seal_pos.en: Warriors who fall within 3 tiles are sealed in ink: they cannot be revived, and nothing bails out of them.
progression.buildingCatalog.ink_seal_pos.text: Wapiganaji wanaoanguka ndani ya vigae 3 hufungwa kwa muhuri wa wino: hawawezi kufufuliwa, na hakuna kinachotoka ndani yao.

progression.buildingCatalog.longbow_yagu.en: A tall archery tower with range 13 that outranges every siege warrior. It prefers warriors attacking from 3.5 tiles or more (throwers and artillery), but cannot hit anything closer than 2 tiles.
progression.buildingCatalog.longbow_yagu.text: Mnara mrefu wa mishale wenye masafa 13 unaozidi masafa ya kila mpiganaji wa kuzingira. Hupendelea wapiganaji wanaoshambulia kutoka vigae 3.5 au zaidi (warushaji na mizinga), lakini hauwezi kupiga chochote kilicho karibu zaidi ya vigae 2.

progression.buildingCatalog.lightning_ro.en: Grounds lightning: chained slashes and lightning strikes within 3 tiles hit the rod instead, charging it. When fully charged it fires the lightning back.
progression.buildingCatalog.lightning_ro.text: Hupeleka radi ardhini: mapigo ya mnyororo na radi ndani ya vigae 3 hupiga fimbo badala yake, na kuichaji. Ikijaa chaji kikamilifu hurudisha radi.

roster.warriors.shinobi.ability.text.en: Cheap and fast; the first warrior every clan trains.
roster.warriors.shinobi.ability.text.text: Nafuu na mwepesi; mpiganaji wa kwanza ambaye kila ukoo hufunza.

roster.warriors.twin_fang_dancer.ability.en: Every hit lands twice, on its target and the next building beside it.
roster.warriors.twin_fang_dancer.ability.text: Kila pigo hutua mara mbili, kwenye lengo lake na kwenye jengo linalofuata kando yake.

roster.warriors.wind_step_assassin.abili.en: Dashes to a new target; the first hit after each dash deals double damage.
roster.warriors.wind_step_assassin.abili.text: Huruka hadi lengo jipya; pigo la kwanza baada ya kila mruko huleta madhara maradufu.

roster.warriors.moonblade_master.ability.en: Every fourth strike is a crescent slash for 2.5x damage.
roster.warriors.moonblade_master.ability.text: Kila pigo la nne ni mkato wa hilali wenye madhara ya 2.5x.

roster.warriors.storm_sovereign.ability..en: Slashes arc between up to three nearby buildings.
roster.warriors.storm_sovereign.ability..text: Mapigo huruka kati ya hadi majengo matatu yaliyo karibu.

roster.warriors.kunai_adept.ability.text.en: Fragile ranged damage from behind the front line.
roster.warriors.kunai_adept.ability.text.text: Madhara ya mbali, dhaifu, kutoka nyuma ya mstari wa mbele.

roster.warriors.shuriken_storm.ability.t.en: Throws three shuriken at once; small splash.
roster.warriors.shuriken_storm.ability.t.text: Hurusha shuriken tatu kwa wakati mmoja; mlipuko mdogo wa eneo.

roster.warriors.blowgun_hunter.ability.t.en: Darts keep damaging a building for 5 seconds.
roster.warriors.blowgun_hunter.ability.t.text: Mishale huendelea kuharibu jengo kwa sekunde 5.

roster.warriors.chain_sickle_reaper.abil.en: Hits make the target take 20% more damage from everyone.
roster.warriors.chain_sickle_reaper.abil.text: Mapigo hufanya lengo lipate madhara zaidi kwa 20% kutoka kwa kila mtu.

roster.warriors.thousand_needle.ability..en: Very long range and rapid fire; must stay behind cover.
roster.warriors.thousand_needle.ability..text: Masafa marefu sana na kufyatua kwa kasi; lazima abaki nyuma ya kinga.

roster.warriors.armored_guardian.ability.en: Walks straight into defenses and soaks their fire.
roster.warriors.armored_guardian.ability.text: Huingia moja kwa moja kwenye ulinzi na kuhimili moto wake.

roster.warriors.iron_monk.ability.text.en: Warriors beside him take 15% less damage.
roster.warriors.iron_monk.ability.text.text: Wapiganaji walio kando yake hupata madhara pungufu kwa 15%.

roster.warriors.bell_warden.ability.text.en: Rings a bell that makes defenses in range target him first.
roster.warriors.bell_warden.ability.text.text: Hupiga kengele inayofanya ulinzi ulio katika masafa umlenge yeye kwanza.

roster.warriors.mountain_shield.ability..en: Carries a tower shield that absorbs splash for allies behind him.
roster.warriors.mountain_shield.ability..text: Hubeba ngao kubwa ya mnara inayozuia mlipuko wa eneo kwa washirika walio nyuma yake.

roster.warriors.oni_breaker.ability.text.en: Huge health; smashes walls for five times damage.
roster.warriors.oni_breaker.ability.text.text: Afya kubwa mno; huvunja kuta kwa madhara mara tano.

roster.warriors.saboteur.ability.text.en: Jams the nearest working defense for 6 seconds (once per Saboteur).
roster.warriors.saboteur.ability.text.text: Hukwamisha ulinzi ulio karibu zaidi unaofanya kazi kwa sekunde 6 (mara moja kwa kila Mhujumu).

roster.warriors.trap_breaker.ability.tex.en: Finds and disarms hidden traps along the squad's path.
roster.warriors.trap_breaker.ability.tex.text: Hupata na kutegua mitego iliyofichwa kwenye njia ya kikosi.

roster.warriors.gearbreaker.ability.text.en: Two jams per warrior, each lasting 9 seconds.
roster.warriors.gearbreaker.ability.text.text: Ukwamishaji mara mbili kwa kila mpiganaji, kila mmoja wa sekunde 9.

roster.warriors.fuse_master.ability.text.en: Plants a charge on a defense that explodes after 5 seconds.
roster.warriors.fuse_master.ability.text.text: Hutega kilipuzi kwenye ulinzi kinacholipuka baada ya sekunde 5.

roster.warriors.ghost_engineer.ability.t.en: Once per battle, jams up to three defenses within 3 tiles for 4 seconds. Shares jam immunity with other specialists.
roster.warriors.ghost_engineer.ability.t.text: Mara moja kwa kila vita, hukwamisha hadi majengo matatu ya ulinzi ndani ya vigae 3 kwa sekunde 4. Hushiriki kinga dhidi ya ukwamishaji na wataalamu wengine.

roster.warriors.tunnel_runner.ability.te.en: Digs under walls to reach any building.
roster.warriors.tunnel_runner.ability.te.text: Huchimba chini ya kuta kufikia jengo lolote.

roster.warriors.wall_climber.ability.tex.en: Climbs over walls and goes for storehouses first.
roster.warriors.wall_climber.ability.tex.text: Hupanda juu ya kuta na kuyalenga maghala kwanza.

roster.warriors.grapple_raider.ability.t.en: Swings over walls straight to the nearest defense.
roster.warriors.grapple_raider.ability.t.text: Hubembea juu ya kuta moja kwa moja hadi ulinzi ulio karibu zaidi.

roster.warriors.mole_king.ability.text.en: Bursts out of the ground beside a defense, stunning it for 2 seconds.
roster.warriors.mole_king.ability.text.text: Huibuka kutoka ardhini kando ya ulinzi, na kuupiga butwaa kwa sekunde 2.

roster.warriors.phantom_gate.ability.tex.en: Walls near it crumble, opening a path for everyone.
roster.warriors.phantom_gate.ability.tex.text: Kuta zilizo karibu naye hubomoka, na kufungua njia kwa kila mtu.

roster.warriors.kite_raider.ability.text.en: Glides over walls on a war kite and bombs defenses.
roster.warriors.kite_raider.ability.text.text: Huelea juu ya kuta kwa tiara ya vita na kudondosha mabomu kwenye ulinzi.

roster.warriors.crane_glider.ability.tex.en: Very fast flyer that raids storehouses.
roster.warriors.crane_glider.ability.tex.text: Anayeruka kwa kasi sana anayevamia maghala.

roster.warriors.lantern_balloon.ability..en: Slow balloon that drops burning embers in a wide area.
roster.warriors.lantern_balloon.ability..text: Puto la polepole linalodondosha makaa ya moto katika eneo pana.

roster.warriors.thunder_kite.ability.tex.en: Lightning hits a defense and up to three nearby defenses for 35% damage each.
roster.warriors.thunder_kite.ability.tex.text: Radi hupiga ulinzi mmoja na hadi majengo matatu ya ulinzi yaliyo karibu kwa madhara ya 35% kila moja.

roster.warriors.dragon_kite_armada.abili.en: A heavy dragon kite carrying a crew of bombers.
roster.warriors.dragon_kite_armada.abili.text: Tiara nzito ya joka inayobeba kikosi cha warusha-mabomu.

roster.warriors.drum_monk.ability.text.en: Nearby warriors move and attack 25% faster within 3 tiles. Multiple drums do not stack.
roster.warriors.drum_monk.ability.text.text: Wapiganaji walio karibu ndani ya vigae 3 husonga na kushambulia kwa kasi zaidi kwa 25%. Ngoma kadhaa haziongezani.

roster.warriors.mist_weaver.ability.text.en: Wraps nearby warriors in thin mist (a small moving smoke cloud).
roster.warriors.mist_weaver.ability.text.text: Huwafunika wapiganaji walio karibu kwa ukungu mwembamba (wingu dogo la moshi linalosonga).

roster.warriors.spirit_caller.ability.te.en: Brings one fallen warrior back to its feet.

roster.warriors.sage_of_clouds.ability.t.en: Once per battle, heals nearby warriors for 25% and grants a 4-second, one-hit shield (blocks up to half their maximum health). Shields cannot be refreshed for 10 seconds.
roster.warriors.sage_of_clouds.ability.t.text: Mara moja kwa kila vita, huponya wapiganaji walio karibu kwa 25% na kuwapa ngao ya pigo moja ya sekunde 4 (huzuia hadi nusu ya afya yao kamili). Ngao haziwezi kufanywa upya kwa sekunde 10.

roster.warriors.ram_crew.ability.text.en: Four times damage against walls and gates.
roster.warriors.ram_crew.ability.text.text: Madhara mara nne dhidi ya kuta na malango.

roster.warriors.fire_monk.ability.text.en: Short-range fire that burns a small area of buildings.
roster.warriors.fire_monk.ability.text.text: Moto wa masafa mafupi unaochoma eneo dogo la majengo.

roster.warriors.bomb_carrier.ability.tex.en: Runs to the nearest wall or defense and explodes.
roster.warriors.bomb_carrier.ability.tex.text: Hukimbia hadi ukuta au ulinzi ulio karibu zaidi na kulipuka.

roster.warriors.siege_bombardier.ability.en: Artillery with 5-tile range that fires on defenses. Stops to fire every 2.5 seconds; vulnerable while approaching and cannot move while firing.
roster.warriors.siege_bombardier.ability.text: Mzinga wenye masafa ya vigae 5 unaofyatua kwenye ulinzi. Husimama kufyatua kila sekunde 2.5; yuko hatarini anapokaribia na hawezi kusonga anapofyatua.

roster.warriors.volcano_cannoneer.abilit.en: Huge splash that leaves burning ground.
roster.warriors.volcano_cannoneer.abilit.text: Mlipuko mkubwa wa eneo unaoacha ardhi ikiungua.

roster.warriors.hound_handler.ability.te.en: Fights alongside two hunting dogs. The handler and dogs share one health and damage budget.
roster.warriors.hound_handler.ability.te.text: Hupigana pamoja na mbwa wawili wa kuwinda. Mfugaji na mbwa hushiriki afya na madhara ya pamoja.

roster.warriors.hawk_tamer.ability.text.en: Her hawk harries a defense from range, slowing its fire.
roster.warriors.hawk_tamer.ability.text.text: Mwewe wake husumbua ulinzi kutoka mbali, na kupunguza kasi ya kufyatua kwake.

roster.warriors.boar_rider.ability.text.en: Charges through the first wall in its way.
roster.warriors.boar_rider.ability.text.text: Hupenya ukuta wa kwanza ulio njiani mwake.

roster.warriors.bear_warrior.ability.tex.en: Hits much harder below half health.
roster.warriors.bear_warrior.ability.tex.text: Hupiga kwa nguvu zaidi sana afya ikiwa chini ya nusu.

roster.warriors.tiger_lord.ability.text.en: Arrives with two war tigers. Rider and tigers share one health and damage budget.
roster.warriors.tiger_lord.ability.text.text: Hufika na chui wawili wa vita. Mpandaji na chui hushiriki afya na madhara ya pamoja.

roster.warriors.shadow_stalker.ability.t.en: Cannot be targeted until it attacks for the first time.
roster.warriors.shadow_stalker.ability.t.text: Hawezi kulengwa hadi ashambulie kwa mara ya kwanza.

roster.warriors.mirage_twin.ability.text.en: Leaves a decoy that draws fire for 4 seconds.
roster.warriors.mirage_twin.ability.text.text: Huacha chambo kinachovuta moto kwa sekunde 4.

roster.warriors.night_blade.ability.text.en: Deals double damage to buildings inside smoke.
roster.warriors.night_blade.ability.text.text: Huleta madhara maradufu kwa majengo yaliyo ndani ya moshi.

roster.warriors.void_walker.ability.text.en: Steps through shadows straight onto its target.
roster.warriors.void_walker.ability.text.text: Hupita kupitia vivuli moja kwa moja hadi kwenye lengo lake.

roster.warriors.eclipse_ninja.ability.te.en: Unseen until its first attack, immune to traps, and has a 25% chance of double damage on each hit.
roster.warriors.eclipse_ninja.ability.te.text: Haonekani hadi shambulio lake la kwanza, hana athari kutoka kwa mitego, na ana nafasi ya 25% ya madhara maradufu kwa kila pigo.

roster.heroes.shadow_captain.ability.tex.en: Nearby warriors fight 30% harder for 8 seconds. Recharges each battle.
roster.heroes.shadow_captain.ability.tex.text: Wapiganaji walio karibu hupigana kwa nguvu zaidi kwa 30% kwa sekunde 8. Hujichaji upya kila vita.

roster.heroes.iron_matriarch.ability.tex.en: Raises a wall of shields that blocks defense fire in a cone for 6 seconds.
roster.heroes.iron_matriarch.ability.tex.text: Huinua ukuta wa ngao unaozuia moto wa ulinzi katika umbo la pembe kwa sekunde 6.

roster.heroes.sky_admiral.ability.text.en: Pushes all flyers forward and shields them from anti-air for 5 seconds.
roster.heroes.sky_admiral.ability.text.text: Husukuma mbele wanaoruka wote na kuwakinga dhidi ya kinga ya angani kwa sekunde 5.

roster.heroes.grand_sensei.ability.text.en: Every warrior on the field heals 40% and ignores the next jam, trap or splash.
roster.heroes.grand_sensei.ability.text.text: Kila mpiganaji uwanjani huponywa kwa 40% na hupuuza ukwamishaji, mtego au mlipuko wa eneo unaofuata.

social.chatLines.random.1.en: The terraced farms look great after the rain.
social.chatLines.random.1.text: Mashamba ya matuta yanapendeza sana baada ya mvua.

social.chatLines.random.2.text: Nimemaliza kuboresha Hazina yangu sasa hivi!

social.chatLines.random.3.en: Who wants to raid together later?

social.chatLines.random.4.en: My artisans never sleep, I swear.

social.chatLines.random.5.en: Good luck on your upgrades today!
social.chatLines.random.5.text: Kila la heri na maboresho yako leo!

social.chatLines.random.6.en: The Stone Lanterns look so calm at night.
social.chatLines.random.6.text: Taa za Jiwe zinaonekana tulivu sana usiku.

social.chatLines.random.8.en: Almost three-starred a fortress just now!
social.chatLines.random.8.text: Nusura nipate nyota tatu kwenye ngome sasa hivi!

social.chatLines.random.9.en: Shinobi rush is underrated. Fight me.
social.chatLines.random.9.text: Shambulio la Shinobi wengi linadharauliwa. Nipinge ukiweza.

social.chatLines.random.10.en: Smoke first, then send everything. Works every time.
social.chatLines.random.10.text: Moshi kwanza, kisha tuma kila kitu. Hufanya kazi kila mara.

social.chatLines.random.11.en: Upgrading my Clan Keep, see you in a day!
social.chatLines.random.11.text: Naboresha Ngome yangu ya Ukoo, tuonane baada ya siku moja!

social.chatLines.random.12.en: Back from a raid with full storehouses!
social.chatLines.random.12.text: Nimerudi kutoka uvamizi na maghala yamejaa!

social.chatLines.random.13.en: Saboteurs on the mortar, then guardians in. Clean.
social.chatLines.random.13.text: Wahujumu kwenye mzinga, kisha walinzi waingie. Safi.

social.chatLines.random.14.en: Who has the tidiest village here?
social.chatLines.random.14.text: Nani ana kijiji nadhifu zaidi hapa?

social.chatLines.random.15.en: Meditating for a bit, guard my village!

social.chatLines.greet.1.en: Welcome, new ally! Glad to have you.
social.chatLines.greet.1.text: Karibu, mshirika mpya! Tunafurahi kuwa nawe.

social.chatLines.greet.2.en: Welcome! Ask if you need warriors.

social.chatLines.greet.3.en: A new blade joins us. Welcome!

social.chatLines.raidStart.0.en: Alliance War has started! Use both your attacks!
social.chatLines.raidStart.0.text: Vita vya Muungano vimeanza! Tumia mashambulio yako yote mawili!

social.chatLines.raidStart.1.en: Time to raid! Go for the stars!

social.chatLines.raidStart.2.en: Alliance War is on, good luck everyone!
social.chatLines.raidStart.2.text: Vita vya Muungano vimeanza, kila la heri nyote!

social.chatLines.raidEnd.1.en: That was fun! Same time next week?
social.chatLines.raidEnd.1.text: Ilikuwa raha! Wakati huu huu wiki ijayo?

trials.modifiers.elite.description.en: Defenses are 20% tougher and hit 20% harder.
trials.modifiers.elite.description.text: Ulinzi ni imara zaidi kwa 20% na hupiga kwa nguvu zaidi kwa 20%.

troops.hedgehog_roller.description.en: Fast, cheap melee fighter. Dashes to the nearest building.
troops.hedgehog_roller.description.text: Mpiganaji wa karibu mwepesi na wa bei nafuu. Hukimbilia jengo lililo karibu zaidi.

troops.frog_lobber.description.en: Throws kunai from a distance. Fragile, so keep it behind sturdier warriors.
troops.frog_lobber.description.text: Hurusha kunai kutoka mbali. Ni dhaifu, kwa hiyo mweke nyuma ya wapiganaji imara zaidi.

troops.beetle_brute.description.en: A heavily armored frontliner who marches straight for defenses and soaks up their fire.
troops.beetle_brute.description.text: Mpiganaji wa mbele mwenye deraya nzito anayeelekea moja kwa moja kwenye ulinzi na kuhimili moto wake.

troops.owl_bomber.description.en: Glides over walls on a war kite and drops firebombs on defenses. Sky Bow Towers, Shuriken Towers and the Kite-Cutter Ballista can hit it.
troops.owl_bomber.description.text: Huelea juu ya kuta kwa tiara ya vita na kudondosha mabomu ya moto kwenye ulinzi. Minara ya Upinde wa Angani, Minara ya Shuriken na Manati ya Kukata Tiara vinaweza kumpiga.

troops.mole_digger.description.en: Digs under walls to reach any building.
troops.mole_digger.description.text: Huchimba chini ya kuta kufikia jengo lolote.

troops.saboteur.description.en: Grapples over walls to the nearest working defense and jams it for 6 seconds. One jam per Saboteur; afterwards it fights weakly. A jammed defense can't be jammed again until 10 seconds after it recovers.
troops.saboteur.description.text: Hupanda kuta kwa ndoano hadi ulinzi ulio karibu zaidi unaofanya kazi na kuukwamisha kwa sekunde 6. Ukwamishaji mmoja kwa kila Mhujumu; baadaye hupigana kwa udhaifu. Ulinzi uliokwamishwa hauwezi kukwamishwa tena hadi sekunde 10 baada ya kupona.

troops.fuse_master.description.text: Hutega kilipuzi kwenye ulinzi kinacholipuka baada ya sekunde 5.

troops.ghost_engineer.description.en: Once per battle, jams up to three defenses within 3 tiles for 4 seconds. Shares jam immunity with other specialists.
troops.ghost_engineer.description.text: Mara moja kwa kila vita, hukwamisha hadi majengo matatu ya ulinzi ndani ya vigae 3 kwa sekunde 4. Hushiriki kinga dhidi ya ukwamishaji na wataalamu wengine.

troops.wall_climber.description.en: Climbs over walls and goes for storehouses first.
troops.wall_climber.description.text: Hupanda juu ya kuta na kuyalenga maghala kwanza.

troops.grapple_raider.description.en: Swings over walls straight to the nearest defense.
troops.grapple_raider.description.text: Hubembea juu ya kuta moja kwa moja hadi ulinzi ulio karibu zaidi.

troops.mole_king.description.en: Bursts out of the ground beside a defense, stunning it for 2 seconds.
troops.mole_king.description.text: Huibuka kutoka ardhini kando ya ulinzi, na kuupiga butwaa kwa sekunde 2.

troops.phantom_gate.description.en: Walls near it crumble, opening a path for everyone.
troops.phantom_gate.description.text: Kuta zilizo karibu naye hubomoka, na kufungua njia kwa kila mtu.

troops.crane_glider.description.en: Very fast flyer that raids storehouses.
troops.crane_glider.description.text: Anayeruka kwa kasi sana anayevamia maghala.

troops.lantern_balloon.description.en: Slow balloon that drops burning embers in a wide area.
troops.lantern_balloon.description.text: Puto la polepole linalodondosha makaa ya moto katika eneo pana.

troops.thunder_kite.description.en: Lightning hits a defense and up to three nearby defenses for 35% damage each.
troops.thunder_kite.description.text: Radi hupiga ulinzi mmoja na hadi majengo matatu ya ulinzi yaliyo karibu kwa madhara ya 35% kila moja.

troops.dragon_kite_armada.description.en: A heavy dragon kite carrying a crew of bombers.
troops.dragon_kite_armada.description.text: Tiara nzito ya joka inayobeba kikosi cha warusha-mabomu.

troops.drum_monk.description.en: Nearby warriors move and attack 25% faster within 3 tiles. Multiple drums do not stack.
troops.drum_monk.description.text: Wapiganaji walio karibu ndani ya vigae 3 husonga na kushambulia kwa kasi zaidi kwa 25%. Ngoma kadhaa haziongezani.

troops.mist_weaver.description.en: Wraps nearby warriors in thin mist (a small moving smoke cloud).
troops.mist_weaver.description.text: Huwafunika wapiganaji walio karibu kwa ukungu mwembamba (wingu dogo la moshi linalosonga).

troops.spirit_caller.description.en: Brings one fallen warrior back to its feet.

troops.sage_of_clouds.description.en: Once per battle, heals nearby warriors for 25% and grants a 4-second, one-hit shield (blocks up to half their maximum health). Shields cannot be refreshed for 10 seconds.
troops.sage_of_clouds.description.text: Mara moja kwa kila vita, huponya wapiganaji walio karibu kwa 25% na kuwapa ngao ya pigo moja ya sekunde 4 (huzuia hadi nusu ya afya yao kamili). Ngao haziwezi kufanywa upya kwa sekunde 10.

troops.ram_crew.description.en: Four times damage against walls and gates.
troops.ram_crew.description.text: Madhara mara nne dhidi ya kuta na malango.

troops.fire_monk.description.en: Short-range fire that burns a small area of buildings.
troops.fire_monk.description.text: Moto wa masafa mafupi unaochoma eneo dogo la majengo.

troops.bomb_carrier.description.en: Runs to the nearest wall or defense and explodes.
troops.bomb_carrier.description.text: Hukimbia hadi ukuta au ulinzi ulio karibu zaidi na kulipuka.

troops.siege_bombardier.description.en: Artillery with 5-tile range that fires on defenses. Stops to fire every 2.5 seconds; still inside a Kunai Tower's reach, and a Longbow Yagura hunts it.
troops.siege_bombardier.description.text: Mzinga wenye masafa ya vigae 5 unaofyatua kwenye ulinzi. Husimama kufyatua kila sekunde 2.5; bado yuko ndani ya masafa ya Mnara wa Kunai, na Yagura ya Upinde Mrefu humwinda.

troops.volcano_cannoneer.description.en: Huge splash that leaves burning ground.
troops.volcano_cannoneer.description.text: Mlipuko mkubwa wa eneo unaoacha ardhi ikiungua.

troops.hound_handler.description.en: Fights alongside two hunting dogs. The handler and dogs share one health and damage budget.
troops.hound_handler.description.text: Hupigana pamoja na mbwa wawili wa kuwinda. Mfugaji na mbwa hushiriki afya na madhara ya pamoja.

troops.hawk_tamer.description.en: Her hawk harries a defense from range, slowing its fire.
troops.hawk_tamer.description.text: Mwewe wake husumbua ulinzi kutoka mbali, na kupunguza kasi ya kufyatua kwake.

troops.boar_rider.description.en: Charges through the first wall in its way.
troops.boar_rider.description.text: Hupenya ukuta wa kwanza ulio njiani mwake.

troops.bear_warrior.description.en: Hits much harder below half health.
troops.bear_warrior.description.text: Hupiga kwa nguvu zaidi sana afya ikiwa chini ya nusu.

troops.tiger_lord.description.en: Arrives with two war tigers. Rider and tigers share one health and damage budget.
troops.tiger_lord.description.text: Hufika na chui wawili wa vita. Mpandaji na chui hushiriki afya na madhara ya pamoja.

troops.shadow_stalker.description.en: Cannot be targeted until it attacks for the first time.
troops.shadow_stalker.description.text: Hawezi kulengwa hadi ashambulie kwa mara ya kwanza.

troops.mirage_twin.description.en: Leaves a decoy that draws fire for 4 seconds.
troops.mirage_twin.description.text: Huacha chambo kinachovuta moto kwa sekunde 4.

troops.night_blade.description.en: Deals double damage to buildings inside smoke.
troops.night_blade.description.text: Huleta madhara maradufu kwa majengo yaliyo ndani ya moshi.

troops.void_walker.description.en: Steps through shadows straight onto its target.
troops.void_walker.description.text: Hupita kupitia vivuli moja kwa moja hadi kwenye lengo lake.

troops.eclipse_ninja.description.en: Unseen until its first attack, immune to traps, and has a 25% chance of double damage on each hit.
troops.eclipse_ninja.description.text: Haonekani hadi shambulio lake la kwanza, hana athari kutoka kwa mitego, na ana nafasi ya 25% ya madhara maradufu kwa kila pigo.
